svg.title: How a job of the CI gets its tools
svg.desc: setup-uv restores the wheels that uv built from source, under a key of the lock files that the job installs, and uv downloads every other package, each checked against the hash of the lock file. mypy starts from its cache of the last run that passed and checks again what changed. Every step that installs, builds or downloads ends after five minutes. After a run that passed, GitHub saves both caches.
